validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: strongly confirmed by 5 independent-origin documents, not GEM-derived: (1) Tallgrass Development LP / AGL Resources Inc. press release, 2014-10-14 (BusinessWire, verified via Wayback 20150725171055 after live fetch was blocked); (2) World Pipelines news write-up of the same announcement, 2014-10-15 (live, 200); (3) World Pipelines follow-up on the concluded open season, 2015-02-13 (live, 200); (4) Natural Gas Intelligence article, 2014-10-14 (verified via Wayback 20141018003306, live site 403s scripted clients); (5) RBN Energy's project-tracker card for 'Prairie State' (verified via Wayback 20170704060641, live site 403s scripted clients) -- an independently compiled database entry (not a press reprint) carrying a capital-cost estimate that appears in none of the press coverage, so it reflects RBN's own research, not just a repost.
